nodes.label: Constitution Check
nodes.community_name: Implementation Plan: Conta ativa sempre visível (Fase 0)

nodes.label: The One Voice Rule
nodes.rationale: Lavender is the only brand accent, marking place, action and focus only; no second accent (old cyan, shadcn blue) allowed.

nodes.label: withSecureAction guard has no caller (custom roles inert)
nodes.rationale: The SRD's central guard is unused, so custom roles from /settings/roles authorize nothing and denials never reach the audit trail.
nodes.norm_label: withsecureaction guard has no caller (custom roles inert)

nodes.label: "Nenhuma tela inventa número" principle
nodes.rationale: Metric depending on uncollected data shows 'sem sinal', never zero/average/estimate; every list opens detail; every metric is derived.

nodes.label: Cosmos ICP (3+ ARTs or 100+ engineers, SAFe adopter)
nodes.norm_label: cosmos icp (3+ arts or 100+ engineers, safe adopter)

nodes.label: O Observatório Noturno (Meridian creative north star)
nodes.rationale: Near-black canvas, instruments that only light up when observed, every reading catalogued with its origin and confidence.
nodes.norm_label: o observatorio noturno (meridian creative north star)

nodes.label: The Colored Fact Rule
nodes.rationale: Red/amber/green reserved for negative-critical, attention-or-money, and positive fact; category/role/decoration use accent, blue or purple.

nodes.label: The Color-Plus-Word Rule
nodes.rationale: State never rides on colour alone: StatusDot carries a label, heatmap cell carries the number, charts carry a legend — an accessibility requirement (NFR-2).

nodes.label: The Four-Slot Rule
nodes.rationale: Every tone exists as --x, --x-rgb, --x-soft, --x-text; text uses -text, background -soft, border rgba(x,.2-.35), solid fill reserved for point/bar/stroke.

nodes.label: The Polarity Rule
nodes.rationale: Glyph over a solid fill uses the theme's --accent-fg (white in light, canvas in dark); white on sky drops to 2.2:1, a white check vanishes on butter.

nodes.label: The Mono-for-Measure Rule
nodes.rationale: Every identifier and measure (case code, count, date, version, percentage) renders in JetBrains Mono; prose never renders in mono.

nodes.label: The Six-Step Rule
nodes.rationale: Text size only from the six suite steps (micro 10px..display 22px); a new size is a new step, migrate a literal to the nearest step, tie rounds down.
nodes.community_name: --fs-* six-step scale undeclared in the four product roots

nodes.label: The Single-Uppercase Rule
nodes.rationale: Uppercase only in Eyebrow and mono stamps, always with open letter-spacing; any other UI uppercase is a sizing error.

nodes.label: The One-Cols Rule
nodes.rationale: Table header and row must share a single 'cols' template, or the header column drifts from the row column on the first resize.

nodes.label: The Responding-Glow Rule
nodes.rationale: At rest a card only has --card-shadow; lift, hover-shadow and tone glow are hover responses, and the KPI decorative layers wake only in dark theme.

nodes.label: The Night-Texture Rule
nodes.rationale: Fractal grain and 64px grid exist only in dark theme; in light theme they 'become dirt, not texture' (scaffold.css:131).
nodes.community_name: Grain texture selector never matches (deliberate false positive)

nodes.label: The Dashed-Seal Rule
nodes.rationale: Data from another product gets a dashed border plus lock, marked read-only: 'the dashed border says not yours, the lock says not editable here.'

nodes.label: Shared base across Charter/Meridian/Scaffold/Signal (cosmos kit + charter/base.tsx)
nodes.norm_label: shared base across charter/meridian/scaffold/signal (cosmos kit + charter/base.tsx)

nodes.label: No shared token file across the four product .css copies
nodes.rationale: charter.css/meridian.css/scaffold.css/signal.css are separate rescoped copies with no common file; changing one token means changing all four, and copies already diverge.
nodes.norm_label: no shared token file across the four product .css copies

nodes.label: --fs-* six-step scale undeclared in the four product roots
nodes.rationale: The six steps live only in .cosmos-root; under Charter/Meridian/Scaffold/Signal roots FS.* does not resolve and text falls back to the 16px body size.
nodes.community_name: --fs-* six-step scale undeclared in the four product roots
nodes.norm_label: --fs-* six-step scale undeclared in the four product roots

nodes.label: Grain texture selector never matches (deliberate false positive)
nodes.rationale: The .grain selector needs a descendant of the product root, but the shell puts both classes on the same element, so grain never renders; Impeccable flags it as a known false positive.
nodes.community_name: Grain texture selector never matches (deliberate false positive)
nodes.norm_label: grain texture selector never matches (deliberate false positive)

nodes.label: --neutral/--neutral-rgb missing in meridian.css
nodes.rationale: Radar's dashed median and BenchBand's p25-p75 band consume --neutral, but meridian.css never declares it, so the two elements do not paint.

nodes.label: Buttons have no :hover state (system decision)
nodes.rationale: No product's .btn defines :hover; the only feedback is :active — a deliberate decision from Charter wave 6, not an oversight.

nodes.label: ADR-0010: each product root is self-sufficient
nodes.rationale: Meridian must not bring in Cosmos's lavender accent (#5e6ad2) or import cosmos.css — each of the four raizes stays self-contained.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0010: each product root is self-sufficient

nodes.label: ADR-0004: no persona switcher in topbar
nodes.rationale: Role comes from the session; porting the prototype's persona switcher into the topbar would be a privilege-escalation vector.
nodes.community_name: ADR-0004: no persona switcher in topbar
nodes.norm_label: adr-0004: no persona switcher in topbar

nodes.label: Consultancy operates Meridian on behalf of clients (decision 2026-09-22)
nodes.rationale: The Nebuloz consultancy runs the diagnostic across client organizations from one Nebuloz tenant, conducting the whole flow end to end.
nodes.norm_label: consultancy operates meridian on behalf of clients (decision 2026-09-22)

nodes.label: Confidence scale is not actually unified across products
nodes.rationale: Scaffold duplicates the enum and seal, Signal uses 0-100 with Alta/Média/Baixa, Cosmos uses LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH in WSJF, though the scale screen claims all apply the same seal.
nodes.norm_label: confidence scale is not actually unified across products

nodes.label: Answers stay editable after closing despite append-only claim
nodes.rationale: The UI states 'Respostas e overrides são append-only' but responses remain editable after the assessment closes.
nodes.norm_label: answers stay editable after closing despite append-only claim

nodes.label: Gap severity uses fixed 60 instead of battery threshold
nodes.rationale: Severity computation should use the battery's own threshold but is hardcoded to 60, an integrity issue flagged for correction.
nodes.norm_label: gap severity uses fixed 60 instead of battery threshold

nodes.label: Evidence file survives LGPD deletion
nodes.rationale: Uploaded evidence outlives the LGPD elimination flow, an unresolved data-retention integrity gap.

nodes.label: Declare retention instead of drawing a misleading small-sample chart
nodes.rationale: With cohort below n=5 the report states that it withheld the comparison rather than draw a chart that would read as 'estatística de mentira.'
nodes.norm_label: declare retention instead of drawing a misleading small-sample chart

nodes.label: Open decision: what scope ships as V1.1
nodes.rationale: Which recorte becomes V1.1 (create assessment, indicate respondent, roles, finalize, PDF) is unresolved before the first sale.
nodes.norm_label: open decision: what scope ships as v1.1

nodes.label: "Número defensável" principle
nodes.rationale: Every final score is traceable to answers or to a justified override, and the computed value is never erased by the override.

nodes.label: Meridian (produto)
nodes.rationale: AVALIAR — 'Estamos prontos?': diagnóstico de prontidão para IA em cinco eixos, em que a discordância entre respondentes vira dado auditável em vez de sumir na média.

nodes.label: Escala de confiança: medido, estimado, declarado
nodes.rationale: Vocabulário único que deveria ser reusado por Signal, Scaffold e Cosmos; cada um hoje redefine seu próprio enum de confiança.
nodes.norm_label: escala de confianca: medido, estimado, declarado

nodes.label: Signal (produto, referenciado — cita avaliação sem recalcular)
nodes.norm_label: signal (produto, referenciado — cita avaliacao sem recalcular)

nodes.label: Confiança por fatores ponderados (escala própria 0–100)
nodes.rationale: Faixas Alta, Média e Baixa sobre escore 0–100, que mede o método; gap com o Mapa — a escala de confiança é do Meridian (medido/estimado/declarado), e o Signal deveria reusar o vocabulário, não inventar outro (S-30).

nodes.label: Causa 3: conta ativa default escolhida sem orderBy (findFirst não determinístico, 2 lugares)
nodes.norm_label: causa 3: conta ativa default escolhida sem orderby (findfirst nao deterministico, 2 lugares)

nodes.label: Decision 2: fallback determinístico — orderBy createdAt asc em requireTenantSession
nodes.norm_label: decision 2: fallback deterministico — orderby createdat asc em requiretenantsession

nodes.label: FR-007: escolher TenantMember mais antigo por createdAt ascendente
nodes.norm_label: fr-007: escolher tenantmember mais antigo por createdat ascendente

nodes.label: T028: adicionar orderBy createdAt asc em requireTenantSession
nodes.norm_label: t028: adicionar orderby createdat asc em requiretenantsession
